contact.contactBlurb: Whether you need a backend developer, an IT consultant for your organization's digital transformation, or a strategic technology advisor — I'm open to meaningful work.
contact.contactBlurb2: Based in Bhaktapur, Nepal. Available for freelance projects and full-time opportunities.

paragraphs: I'm a results-driven IT Consultant and Software Developer with a BSc. in Computer Science & Information Technology from Tribhuvan University.

My work spans both ends of the spectrum — writing clean Laravel PHP backends and advising organizations on digital transformation and IT infrastructure. I've helped rural municipalities modernize their workflows and guided startups in building scalable systems.
I thrive at the intersection of technology and strategy — translating business requirements into sustainable technical solutions.
